final: WITH patient_figures AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_figures AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_figures GROUP BY SEX), sex_mean AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_figures) SELECT AVG(s.alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt - m.mean_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_excess FROM sex_figures AS s CROSS JOIN sex_mean AS m WHERE s.aptt_minus_pt > m.mean_aptt_minus_pt
